_comment: Anthropic first-party API rates in US dollars per million tokens, as published on
2026-06-24. Prices change; this file is meant to be edited. Cache multipliers are applied
to the input rate: a 5-minute cache write costs 1.25x input, a 1-hour cache write 2x, and a
cache read 0.1x. Those three multipliers are what actually decide the bill for an agent:
a long session reads its cached prefix on every turn.
Partner platforms (Bedrock, Vertex) bill separately and are not covered here.
